Method of Attack: Bricks IoT devices by writing random data from /dev/random to all storage drives, deletes network configurations, flushes iptables, adds DROP rules to block connections, and reboots the device
Discoverer: Larry Cashdollar of Akamai Security Intelligence Response Team (SIRT)
Attack Vector: Telnet with default or weak credentials
Indicators of Compromise: Attempts to connect via telnet using default credentials
Execution of commands such as 'busybox cat /dev/urandom >/dev/mtdblock0', 'fdisk -l', 'iptables -A INPUT -j DROP', 'reboot'
